restaurantName: Mayfair Lounge and Grill at The Cavendish London
bio: Mayfair Lounge & Grill, at The Cavendish London, launches a new Platinum Afternoon Tea, inspired by flavours of the Commonwealth to commemorate Queen Elizabeth’s 70 years of service as monarch and Head of the Commonwealth.  Guests can indulge in sumptuous cakes, layered treats, delectable scones and savoury bites which pay tribute to the flavours and textures from across the Commonwealth. This Includes Cypriot inspired pastries, Mauritian streamed cassava cakes, plus delicious finger sandwiches which pay homage to the tastes of the Caribbean, India, and classic English flavourings to name a few.Mayfair Lounge & Grill’s  Platinum Afternoon Tea is priced at £55.00 per person; Champagne Afternoon Tea from £65.00 with a glass of Laurent Perrier La Cuvee and £68 with a glass of Laurent Perrier Rose. Platinum Afternoon Tea is available with a bottle of Laurent Perrier La Cuvee for £72, and with a bottle of Laurent Perrier Rose for £130.  The hotel's location on this quiet street makes it perfect for visiting the shops and boutiques of Bond and Regent Street, as well as being only five minutes' walk from Green Park, Piccadilly Circus and West End Theatres.
pageTitle: Mayfair Lounge and Grill at The Cavendish London
